title: Mon curé chez les riches
summary: My Priest Among the Rich (French: Mon curé chez les riches) is a 1923 comedy novel by the Belgian-born French author Clément Vautel. It was published in Paris by Albin Michel. It was followed by a sequel My Priest Among the Poor in 1925. The same year it was adapted for the stage by Vautel. (This summary is from Wikipedia.)
